title: Patch: holding a card on a touch screen acts as its hover, on every screen and either turn
notes: On a touch screen a finger held on a card opens its hover preview while it stays down, on either turn and on every screen (R2617000); #165 had kept the inspect sheet on your own turn and off the board. With Hover previews off a hold opens the sheet as before. How cards are read only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Hold a card on a phone to see it up close
changes: On a touch screen, holding a card shows it enlarged until you let go, on either turn and on every screen. The hold never plays or picks the card.
